---
title: "PitchDetails"
format: html
---


Read in data and libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
KCLYakkertechData <- read_csv("KCLYakkertechData.csv")
BeltersYakkertechData <- read_csv("BeltersPitcherYakkertechData.csv")
pitcherData <- bind_rows(KCLYakkertechData, BeltersYakkertechData)
```


```{r}
pitch_summary <- pitcherData |> 
  filter(!is.na(RelSpeed), !is.na(HorzBreak)) |> 
  group_by(Pitcher, TaggedPitchType) |> 
  summarise(
    meanSpeed = mean(RelSpeed, na.rm = TRUE),
    count     = n(),
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) |> 
  
  group_by(Pitcher) |> 
  mutate(
    usageRate = count / sum(count),
    totalPitches = sum(count)
  ) |> 
  ungroup()

pitch_summary
```



```{r}
pitch_colors <- c(
  "Fastball" = "#c66471",
  "Curveball" = "#90d8ed",
  "Cutter" = "#9c695b",
  "Changeup" = "#85c873",
  "Sinker" = "#edb462",
  "Knuckleball" = "#6c6cd1",
  "Splitter" = "#87bbbc",
  "Slider" = "#edeb75"
)

circle_data <- tibble(
  radius = rep(c(6,12,18,24), each=200),
  theta  = rep(seq(0, 2*pi, length.out=200), times=4)
) %>%
  mutate(
    x = radius * cos(theta),
    y = radius * sin(theta)
  )

circle24 <- tibble(
  theta = seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 360)
) %>%
  mutate(
    x = 25 * cos(theta),
    y = 25 * sin(theta)
  )

p <- pitcherData %>% 
  filter(Pitcher=="Roy Ralston", !is.na(HorzBreak)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=HorzBreak, y=InducedVertBreak)) +
  coord_fixed(xlim=c(-25,25), ylim=c(-25,25)) +
  geom_polygon(
    data        = circle24,
    aes(x=x, y=y),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill        = "#e8f2f5",
    color       = NA
  ) +
  geom_path(
    data        = circle_data,
    aes(x = x, y = y, group = radius),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linetype    = "dashed",
    color       = "black",
    alpha = .5
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, alpha = .3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = .3) +
  geom_point(
      aes(fill = TaggedPitchType),
      shape  = 21,     
      color  = "black",         
      size   = 4,                
      stroke = 0.5,          
      alpha  = 0.85            
    ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "Pitch Type",
    values = pitch_colors,
    na.value = "grey50"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )


p
```

```{r}
library(knitr)

# starting from your existing table_df
table_df <- pitch_summary %>%
  filter(Pitcher=="Roy Ralston") %>%
  arrange(desc(usageRate)) %>%
  transmute(
    PitchType = TaggedPitchType,
    Usage     = sprintf("%.0f%%", usageRate*100),
    Speed     = sprintf("%.1f", meanSpeed),
    Color     = paste0(
      "<span style='display:inline-block;",
      "width:12px;height:12px;background:", 
      pitch_colors[TaggedPitchType],
      ";border:1px solid #333;'></span>"
    )
  )

# 1) pull out vectors in the order you want
colors <- table_df$Color
ptypes <- table_df$PitchType
usage  <- table_df$Usage
speed  <- table_df$Speed

# 2) build a matrix with 3 rows: color / usage / speed
m <- rbind(
  colors,
  ptypes,
  usage,
  speed
)

# 4) Turn into a data.frame so we can give rownames
df_key <- as.data.frame(m, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# set row names
rownames(df_key) <- c("", " ", "Usage", "Avg Speed")
# blank out column names
colnames(df_key)  <- rep("", ncol(df_key))

# 5) Print with kable, allowing the HTML in Color
kable(
  df_key,
  format     = "html",
  escape     = FALSE,
  row.names  = TRUE,
  align      = rep("c", ncol(df_key)),
  table.attr = 'style="border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 10px 0;"'
)

```
